name: Weekly Competitor Google Ads Radar (winning, new and stopped ads to Slack and Notion)

parameters.content:
## Weekly Competitor Google Ads Radar
Every Monday this workflow reads your competitors' **public** Google ads (Ads Transparency Center, via the Apify Actor `xsi/google-ads-transparency`) and sends one digest to Slack and Notion:
- **Winning ads**: still running after 30+ days
- **New launches**: first shown in the last 7 days
- **New and stopped ads** since last week (monitor mode)
- One summary line per competitor, plus promo codes and discounts written in the ads

### Setup (3 minutes)
1. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Select it in both Apify nodes.
2. Select your **Slack** credential (chat:write) and your **Notion** credential (share the parent page with the integration).
3. Edit **Configure radar**: competitors, country, Slack channel, Notion parent page ID.
4. Click **Test once**, check the message, then activate.

The first run stores a baseline: new/stopped ads show from the second run.

### 1. Schedule and settings
Runs Monday 08:00 or on Test once. All settings live in one Edit Fields node.

### 2. Two Apify runs
**Get current ads**: latest ads per competitor + one free summary row each.
**Check new and stopped ads**: monitor mode, compares with last week (stopped ads are free; new-ad alerts cost $0.005 each, capped by maxItems).

### 3. Build and send
One Code node builds the digest (also when a request fails or returns nothing), then posts to Slack and saves a Notion page.

**Cost**: pay-per-result on your Apify account, about $0.001 per ad (3 competitors × 25 ads ≈ $0.08 per week, plus $0.001 per ad text read by OCR), monitor $0.001 per competitor checked. Websites with no ads are free. Keep maxAdsPerQuery low while testing. Apify sync runs stop after 300 s: keep about 3 competitors per workflow (5 websites took 162–228 s in our tests).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ domains: String($('Configure radar').first().json.competitorDomains || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean), regions: [String($('Configure radar').first().json.region || 'US').trim()].filter(Boolean), maxAdsPerQuery: Number($('Configure radar').first().json.maxAdsPerQuery) || 25, winningAdMinDays: Number($('Configure radar').first().json.daysThreshold) || 30, compactOutput: true, includeDomainSummary: true }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ mode: "monitor", domains: String($('Configure radar').first().json.competitorDomains || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean), regions: [String($('Configure radar').first().json.region || 'US').trim()].filter(Boolean), monitorKey: String($('Configure radar').first().json.monitorKey || 'weekly-radar'), alertOnStopped: true, ocrImageAds: false, maxItems: Number($('Configure radar').first().json.maxNewAdAlerts) || 30 }) }}
